node.date_label: Le Christianisme va-t-il mourir ? (1977) · La Peur en Occident (1978) · Le Péché et la Peur (1983)
node.description: A historian of religious mentalities who examined collective fear, insecurity and hope in early modern Western Christianity. His methodological interview presents interdisciplinary inquiry as necessary but warns that psychological interpretation must respect the limits of historical documentation.
